concern_summary: The lab wants to update the content for their document.
root_cause: A document in the lab is currently outdated in content.
actions: Navigate to Documents and document files through the Settings.
Then find the document of concern based on the lab.
After clicking it's name you should be redirected to the editor where you can then update the contents of the file.
After updating save the file accordingly based on your changes.

concern_summary: The lab wants to add new multiple signatories
root_cause: The lab has new staff which they want to add signatories for.
actions: Navigate to the Signatories module through the Settings.
Then press the + ADD button to add the necessary signatories one by one based on the information prescribed by the lab.

concern_summary: Addition of default remarks to a document
root_cause: There is currently no default remarks for a document where there is no manually inputted remarks.
actions: Navigate to Documents and document files through the Settings.
Then find the document of concern based on the lab.

After clicking it's name you should be redirected to the editor where you can then update the contents of the file, for this case you can add a conditional statement that would display a default text if the remarks is not present in the patient service.

concern_summary: The lab reported that an account cannot access patient services despite having the ticked all the scopes for this module
root_cause: The account does not have proper permissions to access this module.
actions: Navigate to the Members and member group module through the Settings.
Find the specified account based on the provided information.
Once you click the name it should redirect to the settings of the signatory, where you should now check if the scopes are properly ticked
Continue to the Patient Service Management tab and tick the General Rule to apply an override access for a specific account based on the client's needs

concern_summary: The lab wants to adjust the content of the template options of a service field.
root_cause: The current template options has an incorrect spelling of a term.
actions: Navigate to Services through the settings.
Find the affected service and click it.
Find the affected service type and click the value in the column of data type to then find the options tab.
Within the options tab you should be able to edit the necessary template options.

concern_summary: The combined document is not showing the correct signatories
root_cause: The patientService configuration is incorrect in docsgen
actions: Navigate to Settings -> Documents
Check the signatory json keys if they are tied to the correct patientService
If not, update the signatory json keys to the correct patientService

concern_summary: The lab wants to update the service field name and for it to also reflect in the corresponding document.
root_cause: The document test name and service field name is outdated and needs to be changed.
actions: Navigate to the Service module through Settings.
Then find the affected service and click on the name, you should then find the specific service field to be updated.
Simply click on it to edit as needed.
Additionally, check the corresponding document and adjust the code to display the name of the service field as well.

concern_summary: No products showing when transacting an order
root_cause: The product had no price set
actions: Navigate to the Products module through Settings.
Then find and click the name of the affected product.
You should now see a + ADD PRICE after being redirected, and you should now be able to add the necessary price of the said product.

concern_summary: The lab wants to adjust the home service fee percentage
root_cause: The current percentage rate for the home service fee is outdated
actions: Navigate to the Stores module through the settings.
Then find the store that is affected by this fee and click it.
After being redirected to the store settings go to the Cashier Module Settings tab where you will find the Order Item Templates.
You can then edit the necessary percentages and calculations there.

concern_summary: ECG Chart image not showing in the resulting document.
root_cause: The code currently does not account for large image sizes.
actions: Navigate to the Documents module through the Settings.
Then find and click the affected document to enter the code editing mode.
Then adjust things such as the max-height property of the document to allow the images to appear properly.

concern_summary: An account within the lab cannot change the priority status in orders
root_cause: The account does not have the necessary access to update this status
actions: Navigate to the Members and member groups module through Settings.
Then click the name of the affected account.
Then go to the scopes tab and give the necessary read, write, and delete access to queues, queue servers, and queue tasks.
